items.title: HTML Workshop
items.note: A browser-based workspace for making small websites without setting up a development environment. Write or import HTML, preview it as you work, save drafts, and export a standalone page when it is ready to share.

items.title: Mind Playgrounds
items.note: An interactive sandbox for exploring how thoughts, associations, ideas, and simple models might behave. Move through a thought-space, grow an idea garden, inspect a small self-model, and try experiments directly in the browser.

items.title: CENTER
items.note: A compact tool for pausing, regaining focus, and choosing a next step when attention feels scattered. Open it for a quick reset rather than another complicated productivity system.

items.title: Add
items.note: A deliberately simple addition tool for quick arithmetic. No setup or extra features to get in the way: enter the numbers and get the result.

items.title: Speech
items.note: A lightweight text-to-speech tool that uses the voices available in your browser. Type or paste text and listen to it aloud, useful for proofreading, accessibility, or hearing how words sound.

items.title: Pixie Seeker
items.note: A playful little discovery interface for following curiosity and finding something unexpected to explore. It is an experiment in making search feel more like wandering than filling out a form.

items.title: GeminiForge
items.note: A browser-based interface for experimenting with Google's Gemini AI models. It provides a focused place to send prompts and work with model responses without building a chat application from scratch.

items.title: GeminiForge Studio
items.note: A visual workspace for creating HTML and seeing the result beside the code. It brings editing and preview together so small interface ideas can be tested quickly.

items.title: Ghost Turk
items.note: A small arcade game built around a board that refuses to stay still. Play a quick round, watch the grid change, and see how well you adapt as the puzzle shifts.

items.title: BEAN
items.note: A tiny life simulation centered on a character living through everyday needs and the passage of time. Watch a simple world evolve and explore how small decisions shape its behavior.

items.title: Loop
items.note: A compact physics experiment built around motion along a rail. It is a small interactive playground for seeing how movement, momentum, and the shape of a track combine.

items.title: VOIDD Tools Directory
items.note: A central index of browser-based utilities collected across the VOIDD projects. Browse the available tools by purpose and jump directly into the ones that solve a practical task.

items.title: Developer Tools Directory
items.note: A curated starting point for developers looking for useful software, AI coding assistants, and technical resources. The directory is intended to reduce discovery time and make promising tools easier to compare.

items.title: Tools for Everyone
items.note: A public collection of free tools intended to be useful without a complicated setup or purchase. Explore the available utilities and use the ones that fit the task at hand.

items.title: Physical Computing & Energy
items.note: An exploration of the physical foundations behind computation, including the energy required to store, move, and process information. It connects abstract ideas about computing to the material systems and power demands that make it possible.

items.title: VOIDD Labs
items.note: The broader VOIDD Labs site: a public home for tools, publications, experiments, and other projects. Visit it to browse the wider collection beyond the experiments hosted in this hub.

items.title: Things Worth Making
items.note: A field guide to turning curiosity into things that exist outside the imagination. It explores practical making, creative tools, intelligence, experiments, and the value of learning from real use rather than treating an idea as finished when it sounds convincing.

items.title: Intelligence Beyond Models
items.note: This working paper asks how intelligence should be evaluated when a system has to act, receive feedback, and adapt. It looks beyond fluent answers toward observable learning, recovery from mistakes, and reliable results in an environment.

items.title: Context Is Not Memory
items.note: This paper distinguishes remembering past information from representing the situation that matters now. It explores how entities, relationships, conditions, evidence, and uncertainty can help a system understand what is happening instead of merely retrieving facts.

items.title: Bot Detect: Behavior Before Labels
items.note: This paper examines how to distinguish automated activity from harmful behavior without treating every bot as a threat. It focuses on observable signals, evidence quality, uncertainty, and proportionate responses that reduce false positives.

items.title: The Outcome-First Falsification Loop
items.note: A practical method for turning a broad idea into one small experiment with an observable result. The loop emphasizes choosing a concrete outcome, testing assumptions against evidence, and changing course when reality disagrees.

items.title: Palette Lab
items.note: A quick color playground for generating five-color palettes, locking the shades you like, and copying the result. It is a small design utility and an experiment in making useful creative tools that open instantly in a browser.

items.title: Life Grid
items.note: A playable cellular automaton inspired by Conway's Game of Life. Draw cells, run the simulation, step through generations, and watch simple local rules produce patterns that can look surprisingly alive.

items.title: Price Sandbox
items.note: A lightweight pricing calculator for testing the basic economics of a small offer. Change price, direct cost, sales volume, and fixed costs to see the estimated monthly remainder and break-even sales volume.

items.title: Decision Dice
items.note: A tiny random choice tool: enter a list of possibilities and roll to select one. Use it to break a tie, pick a creative constraint, or let chance introduce a direction you might not have chosen yourself.
